THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LOGAN, CHARLOTTE D. LOGAN, DELORIS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT EMPLOYMENT DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT (EDD) $772.00 PRINCIPAL, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $832.00, DEFENDANT EDD SHALL PAY TO PLAINTIFF CHARLOTTE LOGAN $772.00 IN PRINCIPAL PLUS COSTS.
